wins: Maintained consistent action pacing across the episode, keeping reward accumulation stable despite lack of completion.
Engaged mentors proactively (10 times) to clarify environment constraints, demonstrating effective utilization of guidance resources.
fails: Failed to achieve mission success, ending with 0% success rate despite full reward tile completion.
No successful escalation of privileges was achieved, indicating missing critical exploit or incorrect technique choice.
key_outcomes.summary: Run maintained consistent engagement and reward flow but could not convert effort into mission success; focus required on closing the final exploitation steps.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to identify and exploit a viable privilege escalation vector after reconnaissance completed

skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration using nmap scripts to harvest user and service information

skill_cards.if_condition: When a known service version is identified and lacks recent patching
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to targeted exploit chain referencing CVE database and test via controlled payload

skill_cards.if_condition: After reconnaissance yields valid credentials and no direct shell access
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt sudo-based privilege escalation and verify sudoers entries before exploiting
